fields.text: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field.
What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
I used to be addicted to soap, but I am clean now.
I asked my dog what two minus two is. He said nothing.
I would tell you a construction joke, but I am still working on it.
I used to hate facial hair, but then it grew on me.
I am reading a book about anti-gravity. It is impossible to put down.
Why do fathers take an extra pair of socks golfing? In case they get a hole in one.
I ordered a chicken and an egg online. I will let you know which comes first.
Why did the math book look sad? It had too many problems.
I do not trust stairs. They are always up to something.
What did one wall say to the other wall? I will meet you at the corner.
I told my wife she should embrace her mistakes. She gave me a hug.
Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
I only seem to get sick on weekdays. I must have a weekend immune system.
What do you call cheese that is not yours? Nacho cheese.
Why cannot a nose be twelve inches long? Because then it would be a foot.
I made a pencil with two erasers. It was pointless.
Why did the coffee file a police report? It got mugged.
I used to run a dating service for chickens, but I was struggling to make hens meet.
Why did the tomato turn red? Because it saw the salad dressing.
I have a joke about paper, but it is tearable.
Why did the golfer bring two pairs of pants? In case he got a hole in one.
I am friends with all electricians. We have good current connections.
What do you call a factory that makes okay products? A satisfactory.
I tried to catch fog yesterday. I mist.
Why do bees have sticky hair? Because they use honeycombs.
I bought a ceiling fan the other day. Complete waste of money. He just stands there applauding and saying he loves ceilings.
What do you call a fish wearing a bowtie? Sofishticated.
I used to be a baker, but I could not make enough dough.
Why did the cookie go to the doctor? It felt crummy.
I do not play soccer because I enjoy the sport. I am just doing it for kicks.
What do you call an alligator in a vest? An investigator.
Why did the computer go to the doctor? It had a virus.
I would tell you a joke about time travel, but you did not like it.
Why did the stadium get hot after the game? All the fans left.
I asked my calendar why it was so popular. It said its days were numbered.
